games.name: Pixel Platformer
games.blurb: Pixel Platformer Ultra: jump through themed worlds with chiptune music, fire flowers, turtles, checkpoints, moving platforms and a boss.
games.author: Ying

games.name: Lumen Coil
games.blurb: The swarm game, split out of Ssnake's tree: a cooperative top-down survival run with evolving spirit weapons, companion formations, escalating swarms, elites and a multi-phase boss.
games.author: MEME

games.name: Chimp Battle
games.blurb: Fight as a chimp in fast 1v1 arena duels. Waiting players spectate in a fair queue, the winner stays to face the next challenger, and a lone player battles an AI chimp.
games.author: JacobHolst

games.name: Broadside Battle
games.blurb: Renaissance ships duel at sea. Captains sail galleons, carracks and caravels by wind-driven physics, steer clear of islands, rocks and shoals, and sink rivals with rippling cannon volleys.
games.author: JacobHolst

games.name: Paws & Pantry
games.blurb: Cozy co-op farm-to-table kitchen slice alternating morning prep and high-stress meal rushes with shared stations and day-cycle reset. Each player runs their own cat chef in the same kitchen, farming grass, chopping, braving the danger hob, plating and washing for autonomous customers.
games.author: ying

games.name: Panda Badminton
games.blurb: Cute pandas play real singles badminton in a Chinese courtyard. From the lobby, play an AI panda, host a match and wait for a friend, join an open match, or watch any court. BWF rules: best of three games to 21, win by 2, rally scoring, diagonal serves and change of ends.
games.author: jake

games.name: Skate Chimp
games.blurb: An isometric skatepark in an overgrown jungle city: punk chimps carve two bowls, launch the banks and grind vine-wrapped rails across a wide concrete plot, steering their own line and chaining real tricks into scored combos across rolling best-line jams.
games.author: jake
